title: Plain and qualified injection of scoped service proxies
summary: The unqualified consumer now invokes D(L,C) through scoped proxies. An added archive delegate remains reachable by qualifier without changing that route.

change.description: A scoped proxy now inherits defaultCandidate from its target definition. Unqualified injection should see the default service while a qualifier can still select a restricted delegate.

notes: The unproxied control used the same candidacy flags. Each result comes from invoking the injected services.
